Explosions heard near Strait of Hormuz, Iran state media says
Times of Israel liveblog — 21 October 2026, 10:26 pm (Israel time; 20:26 BST)

Iran's state media reports the sound of explosions in the southern Hormozgan province overlooking the Strait of Hormuz. "A few minutes ago, the sound of several explosions was heard in the Karpan area of Sirik, in Hormozgan Province," the official IRNA news agency says, adding that "local sources have not yet disclosed the nature of these explosions."

(Note: claim that US forces struck an anti-ship missile launcher at Sirik is attributed in search results to Israel's Channel 12 via Newsquawk — NOT an approved source; unconfirmed by CENTCOM/Pentagon. CBS live page also says explosions "reportedly caused by a U.S. military strike" — see MORN-GEO-CBS-iran-war-live-saudi-airport-evacuation.txt.)
